title: Rabbi Elazar ben Yitzchak
author: Aharon Hyman

paragraphs: A man of Kefar Darom, mentioned in a baraita in Sotah 20a and in Bamidbar Rabbah 9:31, in the dispute among Abba Yose ben Chanan, Rabbi Elazar ben Yitzchak and Rabbi Yishmael over how long a woman’s merit postpones her punishment. The opinion assigned to Rabbi Elazar of Kefar Darom is nine months. Sifrei Naso, section 50, reads Rabbi Eliezer.

notes.text: At the inspected locus in Bamidbar Rabbah 9:31, Abba Yosef gives three months, Rabbi Elazar of Kefar Darom nine months and Rabbi Yishmael twelve months.
